EnableUiHooks.Name: Enable Mist Engine UI integrations
EnableUiHooks.Hint: Allows installed Mist Engine features to respond to Legend in the Mist UI events. Disable this to leave the system UI untouched.

Compatibility.WrongSystem: Mist Engine Addons requires the Legend in the Mist v2 system (litmv2). Module features are disabled.
Compatibility.WrongFoundryVersion: Mist Engine Addons supports Foundry Virtual Tabletop version 14. Module features are disabled.
Compatibility.WrongSystemVersion: Mist Engine Addons requires Legend in the Mist v2 version 14. Module features are disabled.
Compatibility.Unknown: Mist Engine Addons could not verify compatibility. Module features are disabled.
